<MethodEndpoint
  method={"post"}
  path={"/waves/{waveId}/emission-declarations"}
  context={"endpoint"}
>
  
</MethodEndpoint>



Records the planner's declared marginal greenhouse emission of ONE delivery stop on the wave (the stop's share of the route's driving), in grams of CO2 equivalent (roadmap feature C9; ADR 0016), and publishes WaveEmissionDeclared for order-sourcing's estimatedCo2eGrams. The emission is per stop (the G11 stopKey grouping), never per package. 0 is a legal declared zero marginal emission; a wave with no declaration reports 0 and leaves a consumer's estimate incomplete. Allowed while the wave still runs (OPEN, INDUCTION_CLOSED or DISPATCHED, illegal-transition once CANCELLED or COMPLETED); a later declaration overwrites the earlier one and publishes again. Ranking is untouched by this fact: carbon is recorded, not optimised, in this slice.
